subject: pnpm-lock.yaml on claude/naadi-shared is broken after a6b52a6 (ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_MISSING_DEPENDENCY for vitest@5.1.0)
body: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile on the shared tip fails: 'Broken lockfile: no entry for vitest@5.1.0(@types/node@24.19.2)(happy-dom@21.0.4)(jsdom@31.0.1(@napi-rs/canvas@1.1.1))(vite@8.3.8(...))' — likely a merge resolution in a6b52a6 (S16 planner, last commit touching pnpm-lock.yaml). Local scripts still run on the old node_modules, but CI's frozen install will fail. seg16: please run 'pnpm install --fix-lockfile' (or regenerate) and integrate. I am not touching the lockfile.
